title: en-te-hi-vocabulary-dictionary.json
description: Word list used to generate vocabulary questions at runtime. `generators` are declarative recipes; `entries` are pure data. A generator emits question objects conforming to questions.schema.json.

idPrefix.description: Prefix for ids of questions generated from this file.

word.description: The headword. `en` is the word being taught; `te` and `hi` are its translations, so this field can serve both directions of a translation drill.

meaning.description: A short definition — longer than the translation, used as the option text for meaning questions.

example.description: One sentence using the word. Also used as the stem of fill-in-the-blank generators.

categoryHint.description: Category stamped on questions generated from this entry unless the generator overrides it.
